label: preparing
what: Likely preparations for a gathering in the great hall, possibly a surprise celebration of my forty years as mayor: builder has arranged an eighteen-hundred lighting inspection tomorrow to bring me there, and Freight apparently delivered bread, with twenty-four fresh loaves found on a hall table. Their coordination and the celebration's purpose are inferred, not confirmed. Secretary is recording the inspection but appears unaware of the bread's purpose; no other knowing helpers are established.
